name: vibe_engine
description: The conversation implements a **Vibe Engine module** for the `codx-junior` project, enabling AI-driven iterative code editing sessions. It introduces four new classes: `VibeSession` (state tracking), `VibeFileResolver` (knowledge-based file discovery), `VibeCodeEditor` (AI response parsing and file writing), and `VibeEngine` (main orchestrator). The engine iteratively searches for relevant project files up to 5 times, refining queries when no results are found, before falling back to asking the user for guidance. Code changes are extracted from AI responses via regex-parsed code blocks and written directly to disk with full change tracking. Finally, `ChatEngine` is updated to route `chat_mode == "vibe"` messages through the new `VibeEngine` pipeline.

messages.content:
Create a vibe_engine module for chat mode vibe coding. It will receive a chat and settings related with the project.
We must manage a vibe session, so each new message will be a change to do on the project files.
Before starting coding, define a flow and what's going to be needed to be able to find the right files to change, edit them and update. Process could requiere multiple steps and query Knowledge to find the right files. Agent will iterate max 5 iterations to find the files and produce the changes if it's not possible it will generate ask the user for support adding all found resources (if any)
